occlusion_validation.method: Exact projected edge crossing partition, then analytic ray/axis-aligned-box interior intersection at each interval midpoint; frozen resulting intervals.

style_normalizations: Source decorative shading/texture removed; semantic shaded cut regions and die pips preserved.
Distances and cubes constructed in world space; no tracing or pixel upscaling.
Page-label offsets adjusted without modifying world geometry or label anchor.
Source range arrows normalized only where present to parallel dashed dimension lines with solid perpendicular connections.

target_render.change_reason: Repository-pinned target environment preview; any representation mapping is documented separately and preserves mathematical geometry and frozen visibility semantics. Historical pixel equality is not assumed.

visual_inspection.scope: Mathematical objects, visible/hidden lines, fills, label text and placement retained; no new clipping/collision. Target-vs-historical rendering/layout comparison reuses the separate historical source/mathematics audit and is not a new solution review.
visual_inspection.method: Actual paired view_image inspection of all61 historical/target previews; exact staged PNG byte hashes verified against inspected images.
